display_long_description:
With Wimpsody, you'll just have to seat back, relax and watch trippy animation that will match your music. 
With the demo section, you'll discover the psychedelic Baron Samedi and the space ship orchestra's tunes, all locally, with no need for an internet connection or extra headphones, just your headset.
With the Spotify section, you can listen to your music on Spotify while watching Wimpsody's animations, it requires a Spotify Account, and will be much more capable with a premium account. You'll also need to listen to you Spotify music an an other device than your headset. Headphones are warmly recommended to be fully immersed.
With the Micro section, just blast your musique in the room you are in and enjoy Wimpsody animtions !
With the Local section you can play locally you're music :)
And With the Meditation section, you can take a break and just breath, with the Wimpsody's visual trips :)
Enjoy :)
